verdict.rationale: Grok Build is a documented coding agent that edits files in the codebase. It follows build and test commands from AGENTS.md, can run recurring checks of the test suite, and supports hooks that run a formatter after edits, so the core agentic editing loop behind this story is evidenced. None of the four named tasks is explicitly documented as something the agent does. missing for 10: explicit test-writing capability, lint-error fixing, merge-conflict resolution, dependency updating, hands-on corroboration of any of these tasks.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent write tests, fix lint errors, resolve merge conflicts, and update dependencies for me

citations.quote: In plan mode the agent explores the codebase and drafts a plan for your approval before it edits anything.
Put coding conventions, build and test commands, and architecture notes in an `AGENTS.md` at your repo root, and Grok follows them without being told each session.
/loop 5m Check if the test suite passes and report any failures
